behavior: Highly social; forages, roosts, and nests in groups. Walks slowly through shallow water, probing soft substrate by touch for crustaceans, insects, and other small aquatic prey. Flies with neck and legs extended, alternating rapid wingbeats and glides, often in lines or V formations.
field_marks: Long, slender, strongly downcurved red-orange bill
Bare reddish-pink facial skin surrounding pale blue eyes
Long pink to red-orange legs and feet
Black outer wingtips, most conspicuous in flight
Immatures brown above with a streaked neck and white underparts
habitat: Fresh, brackish, and saltwater wetlands, including marshes, estuaries, mangroves, swamps, mudflats, flooded grasslands, shallow ponds, and lake edges; nests in trees, shrubs, or dense marsh vegetation near water.
